breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains both the water temperature of 100°C and the vapor pressure head Hv = 0.3 m, directly repeating the original inconsistency. At 100°C, the vapor pressure of water is approximately atmospheric (~10.3 m), not 0.3 m. The agent should have either corrected Hv to ~10.3 m for 100°C water, or changed the temperature to ~25°C where Hv ≈ 0.3 m is appropriate. Neither correction was made.
